events.description: Unaudited 2026 first-half snapshot: revenue RMB263.390 million, profit attributable to owners RMB100.486 million, and net assets RMB981.498 million at 30 June 2026.
Shareholders declared the FY2025 final dividend on 22 May 2026; aggregate approximately HKD95.282 million (RMB85.657 million), paid on 30 June 2026 from the Company internal cash resources.

citations.quote: Pursuant to a resolution passed by the shareholders of the Company on 22 May 2026, the Company declared a final dividend of HK38.31 cents per share for the year ended 31 December 2025 amounting to an aggregate of approximately HK$95,282,000 (equivalent to approximately RMB85,657,000) to the shareholders of the Company. The final dividend was paid on 30 June 2026 by the internal cash resources of the Company.

citations.quote: As at 30 June 2026, the Group had capital commitments contracted but not provided for acquisition of property, plant and equipment of approximately RMB2,770,000

events.description: For the disputed Jurong management-centre property, the Company applied to the Suzhou Municipal People’s Procuratorate for prosecutorial supervision; the application was accepted, the prosecutor inspected the property, and communication with the administrator remained ongoing.

citations.quote: Regarding the protection of legal rights relating to the property of the Company ’s management centre office building located in Jurong, Jiangsu Province, the Company has applied to the Suzhou Municipal People ’s Procuratorate for prosecutorial supervision, which has been accepted. The prosecutor has also visited the office building on-site to inspect the actual possession and office operation of the Company. At the same time, the Company maintains ongoing communication with the administrator.

fund_observations.scope: Dividends sourced from PRC subsidiaries to qualifying Hong Kong investor
fund_observations.description: PRC-source dividends are generally subject to 10% withholding tax; the PRC-Hong Kong arrangement reduces the rate to 5% when the Hong Kong investor owns at least 25%, and management assessed the Group has been entitled to 5% since 2019 after completing formalities.

citations.quote: As at the date of the financial statements, the relevant formalities for the reduced tax rate have been completed. The management consulted with PRC lawyers and assessed that the Group is entitled to 5% withholding income tax rate since 2019.

fund_observations.scope: Unrecognised deferred tax liability on undistributed profits of PRC subsidiaries
fund_observations.description: At 31 December 2025, PRC-subsidiary undistributed-profit temporary differences were RMB825.794 million and related deferred tax liabilities of RMB41.265 million were not recognised because those profits were expected not to be distributed in the foreseeable future.

citations.quote: At 31 December 2025, temporary differences relating to the undistributed profits of PRC subsidiaries amounted to RMB825,794,000 (2024: RMB709,807,000). Deferred tax liabilities of RMB41,265,000 (2024: RMB35,490,000) have not been recognised in respect of the tax that would be payable on the distribution of these retained profits as the Company controls the dividend policy of these subsidiaries and it has been determined that it is probable that these profits will not be distributed in the foreseeable future.

fund_observations.scope: PRC subsidiaries statutory surplus reserve before shareholder dividends
fund_observations.description: PRC subsidiaries must transfer 10% of after-tax profit to statutory surplus reserve until it reaches 50% of registered capital, and must make the transfer before distributing dividends.

citations.quote: The PRC subsidiaries of the Group are required to transfer 10% of the profit after tax, as determined under the PRC accounting rules and according to their articles of association, to the statutory surplus reserve until the balance reaches 50% of their registered capital. The transfer to this reserve must be made before distributing dividends to shareholders.

coverage.official_channel: HKEXnews listed-company title search and issuer filings for stock 00837
coverage.search_query: All 00837 disclosures from 1 January 2026 through 31 August 2026 16:00 HKT; dividend, AGM results, monthly returns, issue, repurchase, treasury shares
coverage.result_summary: FY2025 final dividend was declared by shareholders on 22 May and confirmed paid on 30 June 2026. The 31 July monthly return showed 248,714,000 issued shares excluding treasury shares, zero treasury shares and no July movement. No issue, repurchase, split or consolidation was found before cutoff. The August monthly return was released after cutoff and excluded.

coverage.search_query: 00837 interim results, quarterly results, profit alert, business update, financial update through 31 August 2026 16:00 HKT
coverage.result_summary: The latest financial update available before cutoff was the unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, released 28 August 2026 at 19:36 HKT. It also stated no material events after 30 June through the announcement date. No later financial update was found before cutoff.

coverage.official_channel: HKEXnews announcements, results and issuer filings for stock 00837
coverage.search_query: 00837 debt, loan, guarantee, acquisition, disposal, pledge, litigation, asset transaction, contingent liability through 31 August 2026 16:00 HKT
coverage.result_summary: The January litigation update concerned the 29 December 2025 final ruling already reflected in the annual-period evidence. By 30 June 2026 prosecutorial supervision had been accepted for the disputed property. The interim results reported no bank loans, no bank-pledged assets, no material contingent liabilities or proceedings, no significant acquisitions or disposals, and RMB2.770 million of contracted but unprovided PPE commitments. No subsequent material event was reported through 28 August and no later pre-cutoff filing was found.

coverage.official_channel: Issuer 2025 annual filing and HKEXnews 2026 interim results
coverage.search_query: 00837 cash location, Mainland China deposits, restricted or pledged cash, foreign-exchange remittance, upstream dividends, withholding tax, statutory reserves through cutoff
coverage.result_summary: Annual filing identifies RMB76.212 million of cash/bank balances and RMB346 million of non-pledged fixed deposits in Mainland China at 31 December 2025, subject to Mainland remittance controls; it also states the statutory-reserve sequencing rule. The interim results provide the latest cash, deposit, principal-guaranteed product, no-pledge and 5% assessed withholding-tax evidence. No later authoritative pre-cutoff update on exact geographic cash placement was found.

limitations.description: The monthly return for the month ended 31 August 2026 was released on 1 September 2026 at 20:00 HKT, after the 31 August 2026 16:00 HKT information cutoff, and is excluded. The latest admissible official share-count observation is therefore 31 July 2026.
limitations.effect_direction: Share count changes during August cannot be ruled out from the admissible monthly return; no separate pre-cutoff capital-change announcement was found.

limitations.description: The 30 June 2026 interim results update total cash and deposit balances but do not disclose the exact Mainland China versus offshore placement of those balances. The latest exact geographic split remains the 31 December 2025 annual filing observation.
limitations.effect_direction: Do not apply the 31 December 2025 Mainland placement ratio mechanically to the 30 June 2026 balances.

limitations.description: The pre-cutoff sources confirm accepted prosecutorial supervision and continuing communication regarding the disputed Jurong property, but do not confirm a reversal of the final ruling, a completed return of the property, a write-off, or a quantified bankruptcy recovery after the annual snapshot.
limitations.effect_direction: Asset recovery and any cash recovery remain unresolved; do not assume either full retention or a recoverable refund.

limitations.description: The 30 June 2026 interim financial information was unaudited, although reviewed by the audit committee, and is the latest authoritative financial update before cutoff.
limitations.effect_direction: Treat the interim snapshot as unaudited issuer disclosure rather than audited annual facts.
